title: PAR-144 AC1015 VIEWPORT reader boundary correction
sliceKind: generated same-library fast regression and bounded parser correction

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.commitDisposition: No commit: the repository and touched paths contain broad pre-existing uncommitted changes. No whole-file staging or unrelated staging was performed.

sourceBasis.authoritativeSpecification: Open Design Alliance DWG Specification v5.4.1, §20.4.38 VIEWPORT
sourceBasis.observation: The AC1015 VIEWPORT body has no R2000+ frozen-layer list; its type-specific reference sequence is clip boundary, viewport header, named UCS, and base UCS. The generated writer frame contained four null references, and the reader warning occurred before the type-specific handle loop.
sourceBasis.scopeLimit: ODA layout informs field sequencing; the boundary diagnosis is established by local cursor/control-flow tracing and a generated same-library regression, not by an independent DWG decoder.

finding.rootCause: For AC1015 the string buffer aliases the entity buffer. After DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle consumed common handles, DRW_Viewport::parseDwg compared that shared cursor against stringEndBit initialized to the data-body end. The comparison rejected the record before its four type-specific handles were decoded.
finding.change: Keep the existing data-body checks before common-handle parsing. Apply the post-handle string-end comparison only when sBuf is a detached stream (sBuf != buf). Extend the generated AC1015 case to require all four emitted type-34 VIEWPORT entities to survive reader callbacks; rename its option to includeLegacyViewportFrames.
finding.behavior: The targeted generated AC1015 writer/reader roundtrip now passes with the expected viewport entity ownership.

versionMatrix.scope: Existing generated reader matrix only; not a native CAD run or an independent DWG parser.
